panes.add.button.description: Button (an empty project or pane), and an item of the session toolbar's + Add ▾ (a quick add with the default provider and settings): adds an agent to the project. Keep it short.

panes.add.caretLabel.description: Accessible name of the ▾ beside the Add Agent button: opens its menu.

panes.add.caretTip.defaultMessage: Configure Agent and Add…, or Add Agent from Template
panes.add.caretTip.description: Tooltip of the ▾ beside Add Agent: its two menu items (use their translations).

panes.add.caretTipNoTemplates.defaultMessage: Configure Agent and Add… (choose the provider, where it works and its settings)
panes.add.caretTipNoTemplates.description: Tooltip of the ▾ beside Add Agent where templates are not offered (the Assistant). "Configure Agent and Add…" is its menu item.

panes.add.configure.description: Menu item (+ Add ▾ in the session toolbar, and the Add Agent button's ▾): opens the Add Agent dialog (provider, where it works, settings).

panes.add.fromTemplate.description: Menu item (+ Add ▾ in the session toolbar, and the Add Agent button's ▾): adds one agent of a saved template.

panes.add.menu.description: The session toolbar's + Add ▾ button: adds agents (the dialog, a quick add, from a template) and saves or loads templates. Keep it short.

panes.add.menuTip.defaultMessage: Add an agent (Add Agent…: choose its provider, where it works and its settings), or save and load templates
panes.add.menuTip.description: Tooltip of the session toolbar's + Add ▾ button. "Add Agent…" is its first menu item: use its translation.

panes.add.quickDetail.description: The detail of + Add ▾'s Add Agent: it adds an agent at once, with the default provider and settings, working in the project folder. Keep it short.

panes.add.templates.description: Menu item (+ Add ▾): opens the templates menu (save this project's agents and layout as a template, or load one).

panes.add.tip.defaultMessage: Configure Agent and Add…: choose its provider, where it works and its settings
panes.add.tip.description: Tooltip of the Add Agent button (an empty project or pane). "Configure Agent and Add…" names the dialog it opens: use its translation.

panes.agent.merge.description: Button and menu item (a worktree agent's pane): opens the merge dialog for its branch.

panes.agent.settings.description: Menu item and button (an agent's pane): opens the agent's settings.

panes.agent.stop.description: Button and menu item (an agent's pane): stops the agent's session (the conversation is kept). Keep it short.

panes.body.empty.description: A pane with no agent in it (the layout has more panes than the page has agents).

panes.body.ended.description: The bar under an agent's ended session (several panes: short).

panes.body.endedLong.defaultMessage: The session has ended. Resume it, or start a new one.
panes.body.endedLong.description: The bar under an agent's ended session (one pane).

panes.body.inCarried.defaultMessage: Works in {name}, the slot kept for it.
panes.body.inCarried.description: A stopped agent's pane: its carried slot ({name}: its name, such as hb2, shown as code; keep the <code> tags around it), its own worktree from before 1.0, kept for it as a slot. Glossary: slot.

panes.body.inSlot.description: A stopped agent's pane: the slot it works in ({name}: its name, such as slot-b, shown as code; keep the <code> tags around it). Glossary: slot.

panes.body.notRunning.description: A pane of an agent that isn't running ({agent}: its name, in bold; keep the <b> tags around it).

panes.body.resumesInHome.defaultMessage: A new conversation starts in the project folder; Resume opens its last one in its old folder, {name}.
panes.body.resumesInHome.description: A stopped agent's pane, for a reviewer whose own worktree from before 1.0 was kept as its retired home: new conversations start in the project folder, and Resume reopens its last conversation in that old folder ({name}: the folder's name, shown as code; keep the <code> tags around it).

panes.body.retrySetup.description: Button under a worktree agent's ended session: runs its setup command again, then starts it.

panes.body.setupFailed.description: The bar under a worktree agent's ended session: its worktree setup command didn't finish.

panes.body.setupFirst.description: A stopped worktree agent's pane: its worktree setup command runs before its next session.

panes.body.skipSetup.description: Button under a worktree agent's ended session: starts it without its setup command.

panes.body.worktree.defaultMessage: Works in its own worktree on {branch}.
panes.body.worktree.description: A stopped worktree agent's pane: its branch ({branch}, shown as code; keep the <code> tags around it).

panes.chip.notRunning.description: An agent's status in the summary chip's list of agents: its session isn't running.

panes.chip.removing.description: An agent's status in the summary chip's list while it is being removed.

panes.chip.tip.defaultMessage: The project's agents by state: choose one to go to it
panes.chip.tip.description: Tooltip of the session toolbar's summary chip ("1 waiting · 2 working"), which opens a list of the agents.

panes.compact.busy.defaultMessage: Available once the agent has finished.
panes.compact.busy.description: The detail of Compact… (disabled) in an agent's menu while the agent works.

panes.compact.empty.defaultMessage: Nothing to compact yet: the conversation has no messages.
panes.compact.empty.description: The detail of Compact… (disabled) in an agent's menu when the conversation has no messages.

panes.compact.running.description: The detail of Compact… in an agent's menu while the agent compacts its conversation.

panes.compact.suggested.defaultMessage: Recommended: the context is over your threshold.
panes.compact.suggested.description: The detail of Compact… in an agent's menu once the context passes the user's Suggest compacting above threshold.

panes.compact.waiting.defaultMessage: The agent is waiting for your answer. Compact after it has finished.
panes.compact.waiting.description: The detail of Compact… (disabled) in an agent's menu while the agent waits for the user.

panes.drop.move.description: Shown over an empty pane while an agent is dragged onto it: dropping moves it there.

panes.drop.swap.description: Shown over another agent's pane (or its tile in the Tiles view) while an agent is dragged onto it: dropping swaps the two ({agent}: the other agent's name).

panes.empty.drop.description: An empty pane (#762): the user can drag an agent's pane header onto it to move the agent there.

panes.empty.moveHere.description: Button on an empty pane (#762): opens a list of the agents on other pages, to move one into this pane.

panes.empty.onPage.description: The detail of an agent in an empty pane's Move Agent Here list: the page it is on now.

panes.failed.dismiss.description: Tooltip of the ✕ on the bar of an agent that failed to start.

panes.failed.retry.description: Button on the bar of an agent that failed to start: tries the launch again. Keep it short.

panes.failed.setup.description: Button on the bar of an agent that failed to start: opens Provider Setup (installing or signing in to its CLI).

panes.failed.title.description: In place of a pane's "Session ended" bar: the agent's CLI exited before its session started; the reason follows.

panes.footer.compactionHistory.description: The last line of the hover of a pane footer's context: clicking shows the session's compactions in the Overview.

panes.footer.compactions.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# compaction so far} other {# compactions so far}}{over, select, yes { — consider compacting} other {}}
panes.footer.compactions.description: A line of the hover of a pane footer's context: how many times the conversation was compacted, and (over the user's threshold) a suggestion to compact.

panes.footer.connectionChanged.defaultMessage: Its login changed since it was added: see Settings → Accounts & Connections.
panes.footer.connectionChanged.description: Added to the hover of a pane footer's connection: its account is signed in as another login than the one it was added with. Settings → Accounts & Connections names a section.

panes.footer.connectionEmail.description: Added to the hover of a pane footer's connection (HI-1756): the login the connection is signed in as ({email}: its email address).

panes.footer.connectionOffHere.defaultMessage: The connection chosen for it is on an account that's off in this workspace, so it runs on its CLI's first usable connection.
panes.footer.connectionOffHere.description: Added to the hover of a pane footer's connection (HI-2108): the agent's own connection is on an account turned off in this workspace, so its CLI's first usable connection runs it.

panes.footer.connectionRemoved.defaultMessage: The connection chosen for it was removed, so it runs on its CLI's first usable connection. Choose another in its Agent Settings.
panes.footer.connectionRemoved.description: Added to the hover of a pane footer's connection (HI-2108): the agent's connection was removed, so its CLI's first usable connection runs it. Agent Settings names a dialog.

panes.footer.connectionSwitching.defaultMessage: switches once its turn is over
panes.footer.connectionSwitching.description: After the connection in a pane's footer (lower case): the agent moves to another connection once its turn is over, then carries on.

panes.footer.connectionSwitchingTip.defaultMessage: Once its turn is over, it ends and carries on, on the connection chosen for it now.
panes.footer.connectionSwitchingTip.description: Added to the hover of a pane footer's connection while a switch waits for the agent's turn to be over.

panes.footer.connectionTip.description: Hover of the connection in a pane's footer (HI-1755): the connection this session launched on ({name}).

panes.footer.connectionUnknown.defaultMessage: Combwork couldn't check who this connection is signed in as when it started.
panes.footer.connectionUnknown.description: Added to the hover of a pane footer's connection: the connection's sign-in couldn't be checked at launch (not the same as signed out).

panes.footer.costClick.defaultMessage: Click to see this session's details in the Overview
panes.footer.costClick.description: The last line of the hover of a pane footer's cost: what clicking does (the project's Overview tab).

panes.footer.costEstimated.defaultMessage: API-equivalent cost of this session, estimated by Combwork from its tokens
panes.footer.costEstimated.description: Hover of a pane footer's cost (≈): Hive estimated it from the session's tokens at API prices.

panes.footer.costFreeTip.defaultMessage: This conversation runs only on a server on this PC, so it costs nothing. Its tokens are still counted.
panes.footer.costFreeTip.description: Hover of a pane footer's "free (local)" cost: the agent's connection is a model server on the user's own computer (Ollama, for example).

panes.footer.costReported.defaultMessage: API-equivalent cost of this session, as the provider reports it
panes.footer.costReported.description: Hover of a pane footer's cost: the provider reported it, at API prices.

panes.footer.ctxValue.description: A pane footer's context used: the percentage of the context window ("42%"), or its tokens while the window isn't known ("120K"; – before it is read). ctx is short for context: keep it short.

panes.footer.handOverWhen.defaultMessage: {when, select, now {Hand it over to a new conversation: click for Hand Over to…, and choose the agent itself.} other {It can hand over to a new conversation when it has finished: not while it works, merges or is on a card loop's card.}}
panes.footer.handOverWhen.description: What to do about a long transcript, in its hover (pane footer): now (the agent is idle: "Hand Over to…" is the agent menu's item, use its translation); other (it is working, merging or on a card loop's card).

panes.footer.modelTip.defaultMessage: {chosenAs, select, none {} other {{model} · chosen as {chosenAs}. }}{provider} {effort, select, yes {model and effort} other {model}} {live, select, yes {of this session} other {for new sessions}}{reported, select, yes { (effort as the session reports it)} other {}}. Change them in {where}.
panes.footer.modelTip.description: Hover of the model in a pane's footer: the model shown and the name it was chosen by ({chosenAs}; none: leave that branch empty), the provider ("Claude Code"), whether effort is shown too, whether it is the running session's or new sessions', and where to change them ({where}: "Agent Settings or Project Settings").

panes.footer.reading.description: Hover of a pane footer's context before its numbers are read.

panes.footer.retryWaited.defaultMessage: This session has waited {minutes, plural, =0 {under a minute} one {# minute} other {# minutes}} in all for {provider} to retry rate-limited or failed requests ({waits, plural, one {# wait} other {# waits}}, the latest from {time}{ongoing, select, yes {, still waiting} other {}}): time not spent on its work.
panes.footer.retryWaited.description: Added to the hover of the model in a pane's footer, after a blank line: how long this session of the agent has spent waiting for its coding agent ({provider}, a product name) to try a model request again after the service refused it (rate-limited) or it failed, so slow work can be told from waiting. {minutes} is the total in minutes, {waits} how many separate waits, {time} the clock time the latest wait began; ongoing yes adds that it is still waiting now.

panes.footer.settingsName.description: Where an agent's model and effort are changed, ending the footer model's hover ("Change them in …"): the two dialogs' names.

panes.footer.stale.defaultMessage: Couldn’t read it again just now: this may be behind.
panes.footer.stale.description: A line of the hover of a pane footer's context: Hive couldn't read the usage again, so the numbers may be old.

panes.footer.tasks.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# background task} other {# background tasks}}
panes.footer.tasks.description: A pane footer's warning: how many background tasks ({n}) the agent started are still running. Keep it short.

panes.footer.tasksTip.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {A background task it started is still running.} other {# background tasks it started are still running.}} Its status says whether its turn waits for them.
panes.footer.tasksTip.description: Hover of a pane footer's background-task warning: how many background tasks ({n}) the agent started are still running.

panes.footer.transcriptLine.description: A line of the hover of a pane footer's context: the size of the conversation's transcript ({size}: "12 MB").

panes.footer.transcriptTip.defaultMessage: Transcript: {size}{limit, select, none {} other { (flagged over {limit} MB: Settings → Sessions)}}. A long conversation slows down the CLI and Combwork, and compacting doesn't shrink the file: it keeps the whole history.{advice, select, none {} other { {advice}}}
panes.footer.transcriptTip.description: Hover of a pane footer's transcript warning, and a line of its context's hover ({size}: "12 MB"): the size it is flagged over ({limit} MB, set in Settings → Sessions; none: leave that branch empty), why a long one matters, and when it is long what to do ({advice}; none: leave it empty).

panes.header.asks.description: Tooltip of a pane's status: the agent's question to the user ({question}, the agent's own words).

panes.header.asksSomething.description: Tooltip of a pane's status: the agent has asked the user something.

panes.header.failed.description: A pane's status: the agent's last launch failed.

panes.header.failedTip.description: Tooltip of a pane's state mark (stalled): the agent's last launch failed ({why}: the error).

panes.header.inputBlocked.description: A pane's status: keys Hive typed into the agent's input didn't reach it (something on its screen takes them). Keep it short.

panes.header.inputBlockedTip.defaultMessage: Keys Combwork typed into this agent's input didn't reach it: something on its screen, such as a question of its CLI's own, is taking them. Combwork types nothing more into it and gives it nothing until it takes keys again. Answer it in its terminal, then press Try again.
panes.header.inputBlockedTip.description: Tooltip of a pane's status when the agent's input takes no keys. Try again is the button beside it: keep its name as it is translated there.

panes.header.inputRetry.description: Button beside a pane's status when the agent's input takes no keys: Hive checks once that its input takes keys again (after the user answered what took them). Keep it short.

panes.header.inputRetryFailed.defaultMessage: Could not try the input again
panes.header.inputRetryFailed.description: An error's title: Try again on an agent's blocked input failed.

panes.header.inputStillBlocked.defaultMessage: Its input still takes no keys
panes.header.inputStillBlocked.description: A notice's title: Try again found the agent's input still taking no keys.

panes.header.inputStillBlockedBody.defaultMessage: Answer what its terminal shows, such as a question of its CLI's own, then try again.
panes.header.inputStillBlockedBody.description: A notice's body: Try again found the agent's input still taking no keys; the user answers what its terminal shows first.

panes.header.markIdle.description: Button beside a pane's unknown state, and an item of its ⋯ menu: tells Hive the agent is idle (its terminal shows it at its prompt). Keep it short.

panes.header.markIdleFailed.defaultMessage: Could not mark the agent idle
panes.header.markIdleFailed.description: An error's title: Mark idle failed.

panes.header.more.description: Tooltip of the ⋯ button on a pane's header: the agent's menu.

panes.header.notRunning.description: A pane's status: the agent's session isn't running.

panes.header.retryLarge.defaultMessage: This conversation is large, and each request sends all of it. A new conversation (a handover, then a fresh session) sends less, which can help under a rate limit.
panes.header.retryLarge.description: Tooltip of a pane's status while its coding agent is rate-limited and its conversation is large: a suggestion, not something Hive does.

panes.header.retrySince.description: Tooltip of a pane's status while its coding agent waits to retry its model request: when its first try in this run of failures was ({time}, a clock time).

panes.header.retryTip.defaultMessage: {provider} is waiting to send its model request again: {why, select, limited {its service refused it as too many requests (rate-limited).} network {it couldn't reach its service.} other {the request failed.}} It tries again by itself{when, select, at { at {time}} other {}}; nothing is needed from you.
panes.header.retryTip.description: Tooltip of a pane's status while its coding agent ({provider}, a product name) waits to retry its model request. why: rate-limited, the service unreachable, or failed otherwise. {time} is when it tries again (a clock time).

panes.header.slotHeld.description: A pane's status (HI-2304): Hive will start or resume the agent in its slot (a worktree Hive lends it) once the processes another run left running there have ended. The tooltip says what holds it.

panes.header.stopTip.defaultMessage: Stop this agent (the conversation is kept; resume it any time)
panes.header.stopTip.description: Tooltip of a pane's Stop button.

panes.header.unknownTip.defaultMessage: Combwork has heard nothing of this agent's turn for a while and sees no sign that it ended: no Stop from its CLI, nothing in its CLI's records, no idle prompt on its screen. Until it hears more, the agent counts as busy and nothing is typed into it. If its terminal shows it waiting at its prompt, mark it idle.
panes.header.unknownTip.description: Tooltip of a pane's status when the agent's state is unknown. Stop is the CLI's event: keep it. "mark it idle" refers to the Mark idle button beside it.

panes.header.untaken.defaultMessage: A line Combwork typed wasn't taken
panes.header.untaken.description: A pane's status: a line Hive typed into the agent's CLI wasn't taken.

panes.header.untakenTip.defaultMessage: Combwork typed this, but its CLI hasn't taken it (it wasn't reading its input): "{line}". Click its terminal and press Enter. Combwork types nothing more into it until its CLI takes it.
panes.header.untakenTip.description: Tooltip of a pane's status when a line Hive typed into the agent's CLI wasn't taken ({line}: the line).

panes.header.watchTip.defaultMessage: {watch}: Combwork types a line into it when {kind, select, agent {{n, plural, one {it finishes} other {one of them finishes}}, waits for you or stops} lane {a review fails, a card is blocked or stalled, or a lane is due to merge or ends} other {{n, plural, one {the card changes} other {one of them changes}}}}, or at {limit} if nothing does. Nothing runs meanwhile, and it takes no other work.
panes.header.watchTip.description: Tooltip of a watching agent's status: what it waits for ({watch}: "Waiting for #12 → Review"), what wakes it (an agent watch: the agents finishing; a lane watch: lane events; a card watch: its cards changing; {n} is how many agents or cards), and when it is woken anyway ({limit}: a time).

panes.layout.name.defaultMessage: {layout, select, single {One at a time} columns2 {Two columns} columns3 {Three columns} grid {Grid of four} other {Grid of six}}
panes.layout.name.description: A pane layout's name: its button's tooltip and accessible name in the session toolbar.

panes.layout.narrowed.defaultMessage: {layout}: shown as {shown} until there is room for a terminal in each pane
panes.layout.narrowed.description: Tooltip of the chosen layout's button (the session toolbar) while the window is too narrow for its columns: {layout} is its name ("Two columns"), {shown} the layout shown meanwhile, lower case ("one at a time").

panes.layout.shownName.defaultMessage: {layout, select, single {one at a time} columns2 {two columns} columns3 {three columns} grid {a grid of four} other {a grid of six}}
panes.layout.shownName.description: A pane layout's name in a sentence, lower case: the layout shown while the chosen one doesn't fit (panes.layout.narrowed's {shown}).

panes.layout.wide.defaultMessage: {layout} (works best on a wide window, or with the sidebar hidden: Ctrl+B)
panes.layout.wide.description: Tooltip of a layout button with three or more panes (the session toolbar): its name ({layout}) and a hint. Ctrl+B hides the sidebar.

panes.leftovers.count.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# left running} other {# left running}}
panes.leftovers.count.description: An item of a pane's ⋯ menu, and a line of its badge's hover: how many processes the agent left running ({n}). Keep it short.

panes.leftovers.end.description: Menu item on the processes an agent left running: ends it or all {n} of them.

panes.leftovers.endFailed.description: An error's title: ending the processes an agent left running failed.

panes.leftovers.keep.description: Menu item on the processes an agent left running: keeps them running and stops listing them.

panes.leftovers.keepFailed.description: An error's title: keeping the processes an agent left running (and no longer listing them) failed.

panes.leftovers.tip.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# process this agent started is still running after it stopped. It may hold the project's folder or ports:} other {# processes this agent started are still running after it stopped. They may hold the project's folder or ports:}}
panes.leftovers.tip.description: The heading of the menu of an agent's left-running processes, above the processes listed: how many ({n}) its stopped launches left running.

panes.list.more.description: The last line of a list in a hover cut short (files, processes): how many more ({n}).

panes.locks.item.description: An item of a pane's ⋯ menu: how many files ({n}) the agent is editing this turn; its menu lists them.

panes.locks.title.defaultMessage: Files it is editing this turn:
panes.locks.title.description: Above the files an agent is editing (a worktree agent), in its pane's ⋯ menu.

panes.locks.titleShared.defaultMessage: Files it is editing this turn. Other agents in this folder wait until it finishes with them:
panes.locks.titleShared.description: Above the files an agent is editing (an agent sharing the project's folder), in its pane's ⋯ menu.

panes.menu.activity.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): opens the project's Activity tab showing this agent's work: its sessions, turns, tool calls and processes.

panes.menu.archiveStartNew.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): archives the agent's conversation and starts a new one.

panes.menu.cancelWatch.description: Menu item (a watching agent's menu): ends its watch, so nothing wakes it.

panes.menu.compact.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): summarises its conversation to shrink its context (asks first).

panes.menu.discard.description: Menu item (a worktree agent's menu): removes the agent and deletes its worktree and branch (asks first).

panes.menu.handOver.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): hands its work over to another agent or a new conversation.

panes.menu.hooks.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): opens its Hooks dialog: the hooks its session has, and what Hive received from them. The … says it opens a dialog: keep it.

panes.menu.moveDown.description: Menu item (an agent's menu, a grid layout): moves the agent's pane one cell down.

panes.menu.moveLeft.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): moves the agent one place left among the project's agents (its pane one cell left, panes side by side).

panes.menu.moveRight.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): moves the agent one place right among the project's agents (its pane one cell right, panes side by side).

panes.menu.moveUp.description: Menu item (an agent's menu, a grid layout): moves the agent's pane one cell up.

panes.menu.releaseHeld.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): a slot the agent's last session there still holds (it ended, but Hive doesn't know everything it started has) is freed for other work (asks first, showing what Hive knows).

panes.menu.releaseSlot.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): its own worktree from before 1.0, kept for it as a slot since the upgrade, stops being kept for it (asks first).

panes.menu.remove.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): removes the agent from the project (asks first).

panes.menu.reviewChanges.description: Menu item (a worktree agent's menu): shows its changes in the Git tab.

panes.messages.cancel.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {Cancel the Message} other {Cancel the # Messages}}
panes.messages.cancel.description: Menu item on an agent's unread messages: cancels the {n} still waiting to be delivered.

panes.messages.cancelFailed.description: An error's title: cancelling messages left for an agent failed.

panes.messages.deliverFailed.description: An error's title: typing the line that tells an agent of its waiting messages (Deliver Now) failed.

panes.messages.deliverNow.description: Menu item on an agent's unread messages, shown while the setting Wake an idle agent is off: types the line telling the agent of them into its terminal, once.

panes.messages.line.defaultMessage: {id} from {from} ({state, select, queued {waiting} offered {typed, not fetched or acked yet} other {its offer not confirmed}}): {text}
panes.messages.line.description: A message left for an agent, in the menu of its unread messages: its id, who from ({from}), its state (waiting; typed into the agent but not fetched or acked; or offered but not confirmed), and the start of its text ({text}, the sender's own words).

panes.messages.noWakesHint.defaultMessage: Wake an idle agent is off, so nothing is typed by itself. Deliver Now types the line once.
panes.messages.noWakesHint.description: A hint line under the heading of an agent's unread messages menu, when the setting Wake an idle agent is off. Wake an idle agent names a setting and Deliver Now a menu item below: use their names as Hive shows them.

panes.messages.notDelivered.description: A notice's title: Deliver Now couldn't type the line into the agent's terminal now. {agent} is its name.

panes.messages.notDeliveredDetail.defaultMessage: It isn't idle, or you are typing in its terminal. Its messages stay in its inbox: try again once it's idle.
panes.messages.notDeliveredDetail.description: The detail of the notice that Deliver Now could not type the line into an agent now.

panes.messages.overdue.description: An item of a pane's ⋯ menu, and a line of its badge's hover: how many deliveries the agent didn't ack in time. Keep it short.

panes.messages.overdueTip.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {One delivery was not acked in time: the agent hasn't said it acted on it.} other {# deliveries were not acked in time: the agent hasn't said it acted on them.}}
panes.messages.overdueTip.description: In the menu of an agent's unread messages: how many deliveries ({n}) it didn't ack in time.

panes.messages.tip.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {A message} other {# messages}} for {agent} that it hasn't fetched or acked yet: offered as its next line once it is idle, or read with cw_inbox.
panes.messages.tip.description: The heading of the menu of an agent's unread messages, above the list of them: how many ({n}) for the agent ({agent}: its name). cw_inbox is a tool's name: keep it.

panes.messages.tipNoWakes.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {A message} other {# messages}} for {agent} that it hasn't fetched or acked yet
panes.messages.tipNoWakes.description: The heading of the menu of an agent's unread messages when the setting Wake an idle agent is off (a hint line under it says so): how many ({n}) for the agent ({agent}: its name).

panes.messages.unread.description: An item of a pane's ⋯ menu, and a line of its badge's hover: how many messages left for the agent it hasn't fetched or acked yet. Keep it short.

panes.pages.agentsTip.defaultMessage: {button, select, none {Page {page}} other {{button} (page {page})}}: {agents}{added, select, yes {, with an agent the Assistant added} other {}}{key, select, none {} other { ({key} for the next page)}}
panes.pages.agentsTip.description: Tooltip of a page button in the session toolbar: which page ({page}), or the ‹ › button's name ({button}; none for a numbered button), the names of the agents on it ({agents}: "B1, B2 and R1"), whether the Assistant added one there, and the shortcut for the next page ({key}: "Ctrl+Alt+PageDown"; none: leave that branch empty).

panes.pages.button.description: Accessible name of a numbered page button in the session toolbar.

panes.pages.item.description: An item of the session toolbar's page menu (many pages); its detail lists the page's agents.

panes.pages.menu.description: Accessible name of the session toolbar's page menu (many pages).

panes.pages.menuTip.defaultMessage: Page {page} of {pages}: choose a page{key, select, none {} other { ({key} for the next page)}}
panes.pages.menuTip.description: Tooltip of the session toolbar's page menu (many pages): the page shown of how many, and the shortcut for the next page ({key}; none: leave that branch empty).

panes.pages.next.description: The › button of the session toolbar's compact pager (many pages): shows the next page of agents.

panes.pages.previous.description: The ‹ button of the session toolbar's compact pager (many pages): shows the previous page of agents.

panes.processes.count.description: How many processes an agent left running ("2 processes").

panes.resume.allSessions.description: Last item of the session picker when it lists only the newest: opens the Sessions tab with all {n}.

panes.resume.button.description: Button (an agent's pane, its menu): resumes the agent's last session. Keep it short.

panes.resume.choose.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the ▾ beside an agent's Resume button: opens the session picker.

panes.resume.header.description: Heading of the session picker (an agent's Resume ▾) in a project with one agent.

panes.resume.headerIn.description: Heading of the session picker (an agent's Resume ▾): the sessions listed resume in this agent ({agent}: its name).

panes.resume.lastRunBy.description: A session in the session picker that another agent ({agent}: its name) ran last. Lower case.

panes.resume.listFailed.description: An error's title: the session picker couldn't read the sessions.

panes.resume.none.defaultMessage: No sessions to resume here yet
panes.resume.none.description: The session picker when the agent has no session to resume.

panes.resume.noneOfAgent.defaultMessage: {agent} has no session of its own to resume. Choose one with ▾, or start a new one.
panes.resume.noneOfAgent.description: Tooltip of an agent's Resume button when the agent ({agent}: its name) has no session to resume. ▾ is the button beside it.

panes.resume.noneOwn.defaultMessage: There is no session of its own to resume. Choose one with ▾, or start a new one.
panes.resume.noneOwn.description: Tooltip of the Resume button when the project's agent has no session to resume. ▾ is the button beside it.

panes.resume.openIn.defaultMessage: open in {agent} — click to show it
panes.resume.openIn.description: A session in the session picker that another agent has open ({agent}: its name). Lower case: it follows how long ago it ran.

panes.resume.pick.description: Menu item (an agent's pane): opens the session picker to resume one of its sessions.

panes.resume.recache.description: A session in the session picker whose prompt cache has expired: resuming it re-reads about {tokens} tokens ("120K"). Lower case.

panes.resume.sessionsTab.description: Last item of the session picker: opens the project's Sessions tab.

panes.resume.tip.description: Tooltip of an agent's Resume button: the session it resumes ({session}: its name) and when it was last active ({when}: "5 min ago").

panes.running.cards.description: Instead of their chips, when they don't fit: how many cards a running agent waits for, in the Overview's Running now (its hover names them).

panes.running.waitingFor.description: A running agent's status in the Overview's Running now while it waits for several cards to change: the cards' chips follow it (or how many there are, when they don't fit).

panes.runtime.hooksMissing.description: An agent's status (its pane, the agents table): its coding agent ({provider}, a product name) has stopped sending Hive its hooks (the calls that tell Hive what it is doing), so Hive can't tell what it is doing. Keep it short.

panes.runtime.hooksMissingNote.defaultMessage: Combwork isn't hearing from {provider}'s hooks, so its status may be wrong. {why, select, refused {Combwork refused its hooks: they didn't carry this session's token.} off {{where} turns hooks off (disableAllHooks).} newer {This {provider} is newer than the version Combwork was tested with, and an update may have changed its hooks.} other {{after, select, start {None came after it started.} other {None came after a prompt it went to work on.}}}} Until its hooks arrive, Combwork types nothing into it. Restart the session; if this happens again, update Combwork, or check {provider}'s settings for hooks turned off.
panes.runtime.hooksMissingNote.description: A notice on an agent's pane and in Notifications: its coding agent ({provider}, a product name) has stopped sending Hive its hooks (the calls that tell Hive what it is doing). why: Hive refused them (a security token didn't match); the settings file {where} (its name, such as "managed settings") turns hooks off (disableAllHooks is the setting's name: keep it); the coding agent is newer than the one Hive was tested with; else what showed it (after: no hook after its start, or after a prompt). Keep the select keys.

panes.runtime.needsInput.description: An agent's status: its CLI waits for the user's answer.

panes.runtime.retrying.defaultMessage: {why, select, limited {Rate-limited ({status})} status {Request failed ({status})} network {Can't reach {provider}} other {Request failed}} · {when, select, at {retrying at {time}} other {retrying…}} {tries, select, of {({attempt, number} of {max, number})} other {(try {attempt, number})}}
panes.runtime.retrying.description: An agent's status (its pane, the agents table): its coding agent is waiting to try its model request again. why: rate-limited (the service refused it as too many requests; {status} is the HTTP status, 429), refused with another HTTP status ({status}), the service ({provider}, a product name) couldn't be reached, or failed otherwise. {time} is when it tries again (a clock time); {attempt} is which try that is, of {max}. Keep it short.

panes.runtime.signin.description: An agent's status: its CLI waits for the user to sign in.

panes.runtime.silent.defaultMessage: Silent {known, select, yes {{minutes, number}} other {?}} min · state unknown
panes.runtime.silent.description: An agent's status (its pane, the agents table): Hive has heard nothing of its turn for {minutes} minutes (? when it can't tell: known is no) and can't tell what it is doing. Keep it short.

panes.runtime.starting.description: An agent's status: its CLI is starting.

panes.runtime.stopped.description: An agent's status: its session isn't running.

panes.runtime.working.description: An agent's status: it is working on a turn.

panes.safeguard.asks.defaultMessage: Its CLI asks what to do about it.
panes.safeguard.asks.description: An agent's safeguard note: after the stop, its CLI asks the user what to do (switch model, carry on).

panes.safeguard.idle.defaultMessage: Idle after the stop: give it a nudge.
panes.safeguard.idle.description: An agent's safeguard note: after the stop the agent sits idle; the user can prompt it to carry on.

panes.safeguard.stopped.defaultMessage: A safety classifier stopped a response{model, select, none {} other { on {model}}} at {time}{stops, plural, =0 {} =1 {} other { (# this session)}}.
panes.safeguard.stopped.description: An agent's safeguard note (its pane, a hover): its CLI's safety classifier stopped a response, on a model ({model}: its name; none: leave that branch empty), at a time ({time}: "15:12", hours and minutes on a 24-hour clock; in a language whose word before a time agrees with the hour, put it in brackets instead: "(15:12)"), and how many times this session ({stops}; once: leave it empty).

panes.safeguard.switched.defaultMessage: It now runs on {to} instead of {from} (since {time}).
panes.safeguard.switched.description: An agent's safeguard note: after the stop it moved to another model ({to}, {from}: their names) at a time ({time}: "15:12", hours and minutes on a 24-hour clock; in a language whose word before a time agrees with the hour, leave the word out: "(15:12)").

panes.safeguard.tools.defaultMessage: Before it, its last tool calls: {tools}.
panes.safeguard.tools.description: An agent's safeguard note: the names of the agent's last tool calls before the stop ({tools}: "Bash, Edit"; tool names, keep them).

panes.session.detail.description: The detail of Open in Sessions Tab in an agent's menu: the running session's name and when it started ({since}: a date and time).

panes.session.new.description: Button and menu item (an agent's pane): starts the agent in a new conversation. Keep it short.

panes.session.openInTab.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): reads its running session in the Sessions tab; the session's name and start are its detail.

panes.session.renameButton.description: Button of the dialog renaming a session.

panes.session.renameFailed.description: An error's title: renaming a session failed.

panes.session.renameItem.description: Menu item (an agent's menu): renames its running session.

panes.session.renameTitle.description: Title of the dialog renaming an agent's session (from its footer).

panes.session.showAttachments.description: Menu item (an agent's menu, HI-1841): opens the project's Attachments tab on Pane attachments, at the files pasted or dropped into this running session.

panes.session.starting.description: A start (other) or Resume (resume) button's label while the agent's session starts, from the click until it runs (it shows a spinner and takes no clicks). Keep it short.

panes.stopped.label.description: A stopped agent's status in its pane's header and on its tile (HI-1881): {time} is when its session ended (a time of day).

panes.stopped.line.defaultMessage: Stopped · {time} · {why, select, you {stopped by you} assistant {stopped by the Assistant} agent {stopped by an agent} lane {its lane ended} closed {its workspace closed} quit {Combwork quit} exited {its CLI exited} crashed {its CLI exited with code {code}} other {stopped}}
panes.stopped.line.description: The bar over a stopped agent's dimmed pane (HI-1881): when its session ended ({time}: a time of day) and why. {why} is who stopped it (you, the Hive Assistant, an agent, its card loop's lane ending, its workspace closing), Hive quitting, or its CLI ending by itself (cleanly, or with an error code {code}). Keep the · separators.

panes.tab.failed.description: An agent's state after its name (its name's hover on its pane, the summary chip's list): its last launch failed ({why}: the error's first line). Lower case.

panes.tab.mcp.description: A line of an agent tab's hover: the MCP servers it has on ({servers}).

panes.tab.notRunning.description: An agent's state in its tab's hover, after its name: its session isn't running. Lower case.

panes.tab.removing.description: Tooltip of the spinner on an agent's pane header while it is being removed.

panes.tab.resumeOpens.description: A line of a stopped agent tab's hover: the session Resume opens ({session}: its name) and when it was last active ({when}: "5 min ago").

panes.tab.reviewing.description: A line of an agent tab's hover: a card it reviews (its name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none) and title, the user's own words).

panes.tab.role.description: A line of an agent tab's hover: its role (the user's own words).

panes.tab.session.description: A line of an agent tab's hover: the session it runs ({session}: its name).

panes.tab.title.description: The first line of an agent tab's hover: its name, its provider ("Claude Code") and its state.

panes.tab.workingOn.description: A line of an agent tab's hover: a card it works on (its name (its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none) and title, the user's own words).

panes.tab.worktree.description: A line of a worktree agent tab's hover: its folder, its branch and the branch it was made from.

panes.table.agent.description: An agents table's first column heading: the agent's name and status dot.

panes.table.background.defaultMessage: Waiting on {n, plural, one {# background task} other {# background tasks}}
panes.table.background.description: An agents table's State column: the agent's turn ended but tasks it started in the background still run.

panes.table.card.description: An agents table's column heading: the card the agent works on or reviews.

panes.table.cardPrefix.description: The agent's card in a line of text (screen readers, a dialog's copy): {value} is the card ("#12 Title", "reviewing #12 Title"). Lower case.

panes.table.connection.description: An agents table's column heading (HI-1769): the connection the agent runs on, or would start on (a login or service its coding agent CLI uses: "Max 1").

panes.table.connectionPrefix.description: The agent's connection in a line of text (screen readers): {value} is its name ("on Max 1"). Lower case.

panes.table.happens.description: An agents table's column heading (Start New All, Remove All…): what the action does to each agent.

panes.table.notRunning.description: An agents table's State column: the agent's session isn't running.

panes.table.project.description: An agents table's column heading: the agent's project.

panes.table.projectPrefix.description: The agent's project in a line of text (screen readers, a dialog's copy): {value} is its name ("in hive"). Lower case.

panes.table.role.description: An agents table's column heading: the agent's role in the workflow (Builder, Reviewer, Either). Glossary: workflow role.

panes.table.rolePrefix.description: The agent's role in the workflow in a line of text (screen readers): {value} is its name ("Reviewer"). Lower case.

panes.table.slot.description: An agents table's column heading: where the agent works ("in slot-b", "carried: hb2", "home: hr4"; empty in the project folder). Glossary: slot.

panes.table.slotPrefix.description: Where the agent works in a line of text (screen readers): {value} is agents.place.short ("in slot-b", "carried: hb2"). Lower case.

panes.table.state.description: An agents table's column heading: what the agent is doing.

panes.table.waiting.description: An agents table's column heading: what a watching agent waits for (cards, agents, lanes).

panes.table.waitingFor.description: An agent in a line of text (a screen reader's description of a project's agents): what it waits for ({what}: "#12 → Review", "B6 to finish").

panes.table.waitingPrefix.description: What a watching agent waits for, in a line of text (screen readers, a dialog's copy): {value} is what ("#12 → Review", "B6 to finish"). Lower case.

panes.table.watching.description: An agents table's State column: the agent waits for cards or agents to change (a watch); the Waiting for column says what.

panes.table.worktree.description: An agents table's column heading (Start New All, Remove All…): the agent's worktree branch.

panes.table.worktreePrefix.description: The agent's worktree in a line of text (screen readers, a dialog's copy): {value} is its branch ("hive/b1"). Lower case.

panes.template.detail.description: A template's detail in + Add ▾ → Templates: how many agents it has and its layout ({layout}: "two columns").

panes.template.heading.description: A heading in Add Agent from Template: the template's name ({template}) and where it is kept (lower case; Hive: one of Hive's own templates, #1436).

panes.template.layout.defaultMessage: {layout, select, auto {automatic layout} single {one at a time} columns2 {two columns} columns3 {three columns} grid {grid of four} grid6 {grid of six} other {{layout}}}
panes.template.layout.description: A template's layout, after how many agents it has (+ Add ▾ → Templates): its pane layout, lower case.

panes.template.listFailed.description: An error's title: Hive couldn't read the templates (+ Add ▾ → Templates, Add Agent from Template).

panes.template.noneSaved.description: + Add ▾ → Templates with no template saved.

panes.template.noneYet.defaultMessage: No templates yet: + Add ▾ → Templates → Save Template… first
panes.template.noneYet.description: Add Agent from Template with no template: how to save one first. "+ Add ▾" is the session toolbar's button, "Templates" its menu item and "Save Template…" the item of that menu: use their translations.

panes.template.save.description: Menu item (+ Add ▾ → Templates): saves this project's agents and layout as a template.

panes.template.scopeHeading.defaultMessage: {scope, select, hive {Combwork's templates} workspace {Workspace templates} other {This project's templates}}
panes.template.scopeHeading.description: A heading in + Add ▾ → Templates above Hive's own templates (#1436), those kept in the workspace, or in this project.

panes.terminal.exited.description: Written into a terminal (in grey, in brackets) when its process ends. {code} is the exit code, a number.

panes.terminal.osc52.askCopy.description: Button of the question when an agent's CLI asks to put text on the clipboard: puts it there.

panes.terminal.osc52.askDont.description: Button of the question when an agent's CLI asks to put text on the clipboard: leaves the clipboard as it is.

panes.terminal.osc52.askMessage.defaultMessage: The agent's CLI asks to put {n, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} on the clipboard:
panes.terminal.osc52.askMessage.description: The question when an agent's CLI asks to put text on the clipboard; the text follows it. {n} is how many characters.

panes.terminal.osc52.askMore.defaultMessage: …and {n, plural, one {# more character} other {# more characters}}
panes.terminal.osc52.askMore.description: Under the text an agent's CLI asks to put on the clipboard, when the question shows only its start. {n} is how many characters it leaves out.

panes.terminal.osc52.askTitle.description: Title of the question when an agent's CLI asks to put text on the clipboard (OSC 52) and Settings → Advanced says to ask first.

panes.terminal.pasteFailed.description: An error's title: pasting a screenshot into an agent's terminal (saved as an attachment) failed.

panes.tiles.back.description: The focus view's button back to the grid of tiles. Use the Panes | Tiles toggle's word.

panes.tiles.backTip.defaultMessage: Back to the tiles (Esc outside the terminal{key, select, none {} other {, or {key}}})
panes.tiles.backTip.description: Tooltip of the focus view's Back to Tiles button: the keys that do it too ({key}: "Ctrl+Alt+Escape"; none: leave that branch empty).

panes.tiles.background.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# background task} other {# background tasks}}
panes.tiles.background.description: A badge on an agent's tile: background tasks it started that still run.

panes.tiles.chipLabel.description: Accessible name of the card chip on an agent's row in the focus view's strip: the card’s name ({card}: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none), the board column it is in ({column}) and whether it is blocked (yes: add ", blocked").

panes.tiles.chipLine.defaultMessage: {card} {title} ({role, select, reviewing {reviewing, } other {}}{column}{blocked, select, yes {, blocked} other {}})
panes.tiles.chipLine.description: A card in the hover of the card chip on an agent's row in the focus view's strip: its name ({card}: its key, such as AM-12, or #12 for a card with none), title (the user's own words), whether the agent reviews it (reviewing: add "reviewing, "), the board column it is in ({column}) and whether it is blocked (yes: add ", blocked").

panes.tiles.context.description: A warning badge on an agent's tile: its context is past the Compact threshold ({tokens}: "210K").

panes.tiles.empty.defaultMessage: No agents yet. Each agent you add gets a tile here.
panes.tiles.empty.description: The Tiles view of a project with no agents.

panes.tiles.label.defaultMessage: {pages, plural, one {The project's agents} other {The project's agents, page {page, number} of {pages, number}}}
panes.tiles.label.description: Accessible name of the Tiles view's grid of tiles: the page shown ({page}) of how many ({pages}).

panes.tiles.moveDown.description: Menu item (an agent's row in the focus view's strip, the Tiles view): moves the agent one place down the list, the project's order.

panes.tiles.moveUp.description: Menu item (an agent's row in the focus view's strip, the Tiles view): moves the agent one place up the list, the project's order.

panes.tiles.notRunning.description: An agent's status on its tile (the Tiles view) and in the focus view's strip: its session isn't running.

panes.tiles.pageButton.defaultMessage: Tile page {page, number}{urgent, plural, =0 {} one {, # agent waiting for you or stalled} other {, # agents waiting for you or stalled}}
panes.tiles.pageButton.description: Accessible name of a page button of the Tiles view (the session toolbar): which page, and while another page is shown how many of its agents are waiting for the user or stalled ({urgent}; 0: nothing after the page).

panes.tiles.pageTip.defaultMessage: Page {page, number} of the tiles{urgent, plural, =0 {} one {: # agent waiting for you or stalled} other {: # agents waiting for you or stalled}}{key, select, none {} other { ({key} for the next page)}}
panes.tiles.pageTip.description: Tooltip of a page button of the Tiles view (the session toolbar): which page, how many of its agents are waiting for the user or stalled ({urgent}), and the shortcut for the next page ({key}: "Ctrl+Alt+PageDown"; none: leave that branch empty).

panes.tiles.reviewing.description: On an agent's tile: the card it reviews ({card}: "#12 Its title").

panes.tiles.rowEdge.defaultMessage: {where, select, first {{agent} is already first} other {{agent} is already last}}
panes.tiles.rowEdge.description: Said to screen readers when an agent is moved in the focus view's strip with Alt+Up or Alt+Down but is already first or last in the project's order.

panes.tiles.rowMoved.description: Said to screen readers when an agent is moved in the focus view's strip from the keyboard (Alt+Up, Alt+Down or its menu): its place in the project's order now ({place}) of how many agents ({count}).

panes.tiles.stripLabel.description: Accessible name of the focus view's strip of agents (the Tiles view, one agent's pane large).

panes.tiles.transcript.description: A warning badge on an agent's tile: its transcript is past the size Hive flags ({size}: "24 MB").

panes.tiles.waitingCard.description: An agent's status in the focus view's strip while it waits for its card (named by the chip beside it) to change.

panes.tiles.waitingInto.description: An agent's status in the focus view's strip while it waits for its card (named by the chip beside it) to move into a board column ({column}).

panes.view.label.description: Accessible name of the Session tab's Panes | Tiles toggle.

panes.view.name.description: The Session tab's two views, on its Panes | Tiles toggle: Panes shows the agents' terminals, Tiles a small tile per agent. Keep them short.

panes.watch.agents.description: A watching agent's status (its pane): it waits for these agents ({agents}: their names, listed) to finish their turns.

panes.watch.cards.description: A watching agent's status (its pane): it waits for these cards ({cards}: "#12, #13") to change.

panes.watch.cardsInto.description: A watching agent's status (its pane): it waits for cards ({cards}: "#12, #13") to move into a board column ({column}).

panes.watch.lanes.defaultMessage: Waiting on {lanes, select, all {all running lanes} one {{lane}} other {{n, plural, one {# lane} other {# lanes}}}}{cards, select, none {} other { and {cards}}}
panes.watch.lanes.description: A watching agent's status (its pane): it waits on card loops (lanes): all of them, one ({lane}: the lane as panes.watch.oneLane names it, "lane combwork screenshots") or {n}; then any cards it also watches ({cards}: "#4, #5"; none: leave that branch empty).

panes.watch.oneLane.defaultMessage: {kind, select, named {lane {name}} both {{builder}'s lane {name}} builder {{builder}'s lane} other {lane {name}}}
panes.watch.oneLane.description: One card loop (lane) a watching agent waits on, in its status (panes.watch.lanes's {lane}). kind: named ({name}: the lane's name), both (another lane has that name, so its builder's name {builder} is said too), builder (the lane has no name: {builder}'s lane), other (a watch from an older version: {name} is the lane's internal id).

panes.watchCancel.failed.description: An error's title: ending an agent's watch failed.

panes.watchCell.agents.description: An agents table's Waiting for column: the agents a watching agent waits for ({agents}: their names, listed) to finish their turns.

panes.watchCell.cardsInto.description: An agents table's Waiting for column: the cards a watching agent waits for ({cards}: "#12, #13") to move into a board column ({column}).

panes.worktree.toMerge.description: In a worktree agent's hover: what is left to merge ({work}: "2 commits not merged into main").
